annotations.title: List the featured cities of the provider directory

description: [Free] Lists the featured cities — the ones with a nyna directory page — optionally filtered by region — costs no credits and returns city slugs, country, region and page. This is not the limit of coverage: search_providers takes any city, town or place name in the world as `city` ("Gardanne", "Bouc-Bel-Air 13320", "Istanbul"), and geocodes it once; the featured cities are simply the ones with a browsable page.
